title: Best BI tools for finance teams (2026): 8 platforms compared for FP&A, budget vs. actuals, row-level security, and ERP data
summary: Sigma, Power BI, Omni, Looker, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Metabase, and Basedash compared for finance teams on FP&A, row-level security, audit logs, and price.
body_markdown:
The best BI tool for a finance team depends on how the team works. FP&A analysts who model in spreadsheets get the most from Sigma or Omni, which put Excel-style formulas and write-back on live warehouse data. Microsoft shops default to Power BI for its price and PowerPoint and Excel integration, Looker and Tableau suit large organizations that need governed metrics or polished reporting, ThoughtSpot and Basedash let CFOs ask questions in plain English, and Metabase is the low-cost option for teams with someone technical. Every price and feature below was checked on each vendor’s official pages on October 15, 2026.


## Questions finance teams ask when choosing a BI tool


This comparison is built around the questions finance leaders and FP&A analysts ask when they shortlist tools:


- Which BI tool connects to our ERP and data warehouse, lets the CFO explore revenue and burn without analyst help, and has row-level security so each department sees only its own numbers?
- What are the top BI tools for finance teams doing FP&A?
- Which financial dashboard software has AI built in for FP&A teams?
- Which dashboard tools automate budget vs. actual variance reporting and explain the variances?
- Which BI tools give a SOX-minded finance team audit logs, SSO, and a SOC 2 report while staying easy for non-technical staff?
- Which BI tools are best for finance reporting and board decks?
- Which BI tools have good templates for finance?
- What is a lightweight BI platform for a small finance team using Excel and QuickBooks?
- Can finance dashboards on BigQuery and NetSuite stay close to real time without heavy setup?


## How we evaluated BI tools for finance teams


We compared each tool on five criteria taken from those questions:


1. **Spreadsheet-style modeling and write-back.** Can FP&A analysts use formulas they know, and can they enter budget or forecast values back into the warehouse?
2. **Access control by department or entity.** How row-level security works, which plan includes it, and whether it applies to AI answers.
3. **Audit and identity controls.** SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and audit log retention, which matter for SOX-style access reviews.
4. **AI for finance users.** Natural language questions, automated variance or anomaly analysis, and written summaries, stated as the vendor documents them.
5. **ERP and accounting data.** Whether the tool connects to NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or SAP directly, or expects that data in a warehouse first.


We also recorded pricing, trial length, deployment, query model, and reporting outputs (PDF, PowerPoint, Excel) for board packs.

## Which BI tools fit FP&A analysts who model in spreadsheets?


Sigma and Omni both give FP&A analysts a spreadsheet surface on top of live warehouse data, so a budget model runs on the same numbers as the general ledger instead of on an exported CSV.


### Sigma


**Best for:** FP&A teams on Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks who want Excel-style workbooks, pivot tables, and budget entry that writes back to the warehouse.


Sigma[workbooks](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/workbooks-overview) behave like a spreadsheet with pages, tables, and pivot tables, and Sigma[runs SQL against your warehouse and does not store your data](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/caching-and-data-freshness) .[Input tables](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/intro-to-input-tables) write budget and forecast values into a write schema in the warehouse, so plans and actuals can be joined in one query. Sigma also publishes a[Budget Variance Analysis app template](https://quickstarts.sigmacomputing.com/guide/starter_apps_budget_variance/index.html) for finance and FP&A teams.


**Fact card**


- Pricing: quote only. Sigma’s[license tiers](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/account-type-and-license-overview) are View, Act, Analyze, and Build, and some events such as data inputs and report exports[consume credits](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/about-billable-usage-events) ; agent messages use credits starting November 1, 2026. Verified October 15, 2026.
- Free trial:[7 days](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/start-your-sigma-trial) , no credit card.
- Deployment: SaaS hosted on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Data sources:[Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, PostgreSQL, and others](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/region-warehouse-and-feature-support) . No NetSuite or QuickBooks connector; ERP data has to land in the warehouse first.
- Query model: live queries with browser and warehouse caching; optional materialization.
- Security:[row-level security with user attributes, teams, or email](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/set-up-row-level-security) ,[column-level security and masking](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/column-level-security) ,[SAML](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/single-sign-on-with-saml) ,[SCIM](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/manage-users-and-teams-with-scim) (requires SAML), and[audit logs](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/enable-audit-logging) that an admin enables. SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II per Sigma’s[security policy](https://www.sigmacomputing.com/legal/security-policy) .
- AI:[Sigma Assistant](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/ask-natural-language-queries-with-assistant) answers natural language questions and only uses data the user can access under row- and column-level security; a[formula assistant](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/use-ai-with-formulas) writes and explains formulas.
- Embedding:[secure embedding](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/create-a-secure-embed) is a premium feature; an[embed SDK for React](https://help.sigmacomputing.com/docs/embed-sdk-for-react) is available.
- Not ideal for: teams without a warehouse and someone to maintain the ERP pipeline.


**Tradeoffs.** Sigma is the closest thing to a governed Excel model, but it needs a warehouse, pricing is not published, and write-back and exports add credit costs. For a deeper look, see our[Basedash vs Sigma comparison](https://www.basedash.com/vs/basedash-vs-sigma) .


### Omni


**Best for:** finance teams that want spreadsheet tabs and Excel-compatible formulas on a governed semantic model, with scheduled PDF and Excel deliveries.


Omni’s[spreadsheet tabs](https://docs.omni.co/analyze-explore/spreadsheet-tabs) bring Excel-style analysis to live data, and its[calculations](https://docs.omni.co/analyze-explore/calculations) aim to be compatible with Excel and Google Sheets, including period-over-period changes.[Input columns](https://docs.omni.co/analyze-explore/input-columns) write values to a scratch schema in your connection, which covers simple budget or forecast entry.[Email deliveries](https://docs.omni.co/share/deliveries/email) send PNG, PDF, XLSX, or CSV on a schedule.


**Fact card**


- Pricing: quote only; omni.co has no public pricing page. AI features[consume credits](https://docs.omni.co/ai/settings/usage) , with overage billing beyond the included amount. Verified October 15, 2026.
- Free trial: requested through sales; length not documented.
- Deployment: SaaS on[AWS and Azure](https://docs.omni.co/administration/security/cloud-regions) .
- Data sources:[Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, PostgreSQL, and others](https://docs.omni.co/connect-data/setup) .
- Query model: live queries, with[results cached for 6 hours by default](https://docs.omni.co/analyze-explore/performance/caching) .
- Security:[access filters](https://docs.omni.co/modeling/topics/parameters/access-filters) limit rows by user attribute;[access grants](https://docs.omni.co/modeling/dimensions/parameters/required-access-grants) hide fields and[masking](https://docs.omni.co/modeling/dimensions/parameters/mask-unless-access-grants) hashes values;[SAML, OIDC, and SCIM](https://docs.omni.co/administration/authentication) for Entra, Okta, and Rippling;[audit logs](https://docs.omni.co/administration/audit-logs) delivered to S3, GCS, or Azure Blob and kept at least a year. SOC 2 Type II[report on request](https://docs.omni.co/administration/security/information-security-program) .
- AI:[Omni Agent](https://docs.omni.co/ai) chat that generates queries, charts, and dashboards; a formula builder that turns plain English into Excel-style formulas; an[AI summary](https://docs.omni.co/visualize-present/visualizations/types/ai-summary) visualization.
- Embedding:[signed iframe URLs](https://docs.omni.co/embed) with a TypeScript SDK.
- Not ideal for: teams that want published pricing or a self-serve trial.


**Tradeoffs.** Omni gives finance a spreadsheet surface and a semantic model in one tool, but someone has to model the data first, and you cannot see the price without a sales call.


## Which BI tools fit finance teams standardized on Microsoft, Salesforce, or Google?


Power BI, Tableau, and Looker are the defaults in large organizations because they sit inside an existing vendor relationship. Each one has a different strength for finance: Power BI for Excel and PowerPoint output, Tableau for prebuilt finance dashboards, and Looker for metric definitions in version control.


### Power BI


**Best for:** finance teams on Microsoft 365 that live in Excel and PowerPoint and want the lowest per-user price for authors.


Power BI’s[Analyze in Excel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/collaborate-share/service-analyze-in-excel) lets analysts build PivotTables on a published semantic model, and[export to PowerPoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/collaborate-share/end-user-powerpoint) turns each report page into a slide.[Paginated reports](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/paginated-reports/paginated-reports-report-builder-power-bi) produce print-ready statements that export to PDF, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and[visual calculations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/transform-model/desktop-visual-calculations-overview) handle running totals and period-over-period comparisons without complex DAX.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Free, Pro at $14, and Premium Per User at $24 per user per month, paid yearly](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/products/power-bi/pricing) . Viewers without a paid license need F64 or larger capacity. Verified October 15, 2026.
- Free trial:[60-day Fabric trial](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/fundamentals/fabric-trial) .
- Deployment: cloud;[Power BI Report Server](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/report-server/get-started) on premises through F64+ reserved capacity or SQL Server licensing.
- Data sources:[connectors](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-query/connectors/) for Snowflake, BigQuery, SAP HANA, SAP BW, Dynamics 365 Business Central, and Oracle ERP (preview). There is no NetSuite connector in the list, the QuickBooks Online connector[reached end of support in August 2025](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-query/connectors/connector-end-of-support) , and the Xero content pack was[deprecated in 2019](https://powerbi.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/explore-and-analyze-your-xero-data-with-power-bi/) .
- Query model:[Import or DirectQuery](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/connect-data/desktop-directquery-about) ; imported models refresh up to 8 times a day on Pro and 48 on PPU.
- Security:[row-level security](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/security/service-admin-row-level-security) applies only to users with Viewer permissions, not workspace Admins, Members, or Contributors;[object-level security](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/security/service-admin-object-level-security) hides tables and columns; sign-in through Microsoft Entra ID; audit events in[Microsoft Purview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/admin/track-user-activities) , with 28 days available through the activity log API.
- AI:[Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/create-reports/copilot-introduction) creates report pages, summarizes reports, answers questions, and writes DAX, but requires F2+ Fabric or P1+ Premium capacity; a Pro or PPU license alone is not enough.
- Embedding: secure embed by iframe and “embed for your customers” through[Power BI Embedded](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/developer/embedded/embedded-analytics-power-bi) .
- Not ideal for: teams that need NetSuite or QuickBooks data without a separate pipeline, or that want AI on a Pro budget.


**Tradeoffs.** Power BI is cheap per author and fits Microsoft-heavy finance teams, but DAX takes time to learn, row-level security does not apply to workspace editors, and Copilot needs capacity licensing on top of Pro.


### Tableau


**Best for:** large finance organizations that want polished financial statements and prebuilt budget dashboards, especially on Salesforce.


Tableau Exchange offers free finance[Accelerators](https://exchange.tableau.com/accelerators) , including[Budget Controlling](https://exchange.tableau.com/products/569) (actual vs. budget vs. last year), Income Statement, and Balance Sheet dashboards. Tableau has an[Oracle NetSuite connector](https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/examples_oraclenetsuite.htm) for Desktop, Prep, and Server (Tableau Cloud is not listed), while the[QuickBooks Online connector was retired in version 2025.3](https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/examples_quickbooksonline.htm) .[PowerPoint export](https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/save_export_image.htm) places each sheet on a slide as a static image.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Standard edition Creator $75, Explorer $42, and Viewer $15; Enterprise edition $115, $70, and $35 per user per month](https://www.tableau.com/pricing/cloud) , billed annually only. Cloud+ and the Tableau+ bundle are contact-sales. Verified October 15, 2026.
- Free trial: Tableau Cloud[trial](https://www.tableau.com/products/trial) including Pulse and Agent; length not stated. A free Desktop edition cannot publish.
- Deployment: Tableau Cloud or self-managed Tableau Server.
- Data sources: Snowflake, BigQuery,[SAP HANA](https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/examples_saphana.htm) , SAP BW (Desktop on Windows), NetSuite (not on Cloud).
- Query model:[live connections or extracts](https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/extracting_data.htm) .
- Security:[user filters](https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/publish_userfilters.htm) for row-level security;[data policies](https://help.tableau.com/current/server/en-us/rls_options_overview.htm) need Data Management (Enterprise and up);[SAML](https://help.tableau.com/current/online/en-us/saml_config_site.htm) and[SCIM](https://help.tableau.com/current/online/en-us/scim_config_online.htm) . The[Activity Log](https://help.tableau.com/current/online/en-us/activity_log_overview.htm) keeps 14 days by default and 365 days with Enterprise or Advanced Management.
- AI:[Tableau Pulse](https://help.tableau.com/current/online/en-us/pulse_about.htm) sends metric digests by email, Slack, and Teams on every edition; Tableau Agent for natural language authoring requires Cloud+ or Tableau+.
- Embedding:[Embedding API v3](https://help.tableau.com/current/api/embedding_api/en-us/index.html) .
- Not ideal for: small teams, or anyone who needs budget write-back without a third-party extension.


**Tradeoffs.** Tableau has the finance templates and visual depth, but annual-only contracts, $75 Creator seats, and AI authoring locked to Cloud+ make it expensive for a small team.


### Looker


**Best for:** finance organizations on Google Cloud that want revenue, margin, and ARR defined once in version-controlled LookML.


Looker defines metrics in LookML, so every dashboard uses the same definition of revenue. A developer can add[period-over-period measures](https://cloud.google.com/looker/docs/period-over-period) , and[scheduled deliveries](https://cloud.google.com/looker/docs/scheduling-and-sending-dashboards) send PDF, PNG, or CSV to email, webhooks, S3, or SFTP.[Conversational Analytics](https://cloud.google.com/looker/docs/conversational-analytics-overview) , powered by Gemini, answers questions grounded in the LookML model.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Standard, Enterprise, and Embed editions are all “call sales”](https://cloud.google.com/looker/pricing) , each with 10 Standard and 2 Developer users included. Conversational Analytics lists token overage rates of $3 per million input and $20 per million output tokens, with billing not yet enforced. Verified October 15, 2026.
- Free trial:[trial instances are valid for 90 days](https://cloud.google.com/looker/docs/looker-core-overview) .
- Deployment: Looker (Google Cloud core) is Google-hosted; customer hosting exists only for Looker (original).
- Data sources:[Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, PostgreSQL, and others](https://cloud.google.com/looker/docs/dialects) .
- Query model: queries run in the database, with a[one-hour default cache](https://cloud.google.com/looker/docs/caching-and-datagroups) .
- Security:[access_filter](https://cloud.google.com/looker/docs/reference/param-explore-access-filter) restricts rows, but must be added to every Explore or users see all rows;[access grants](https://cloud.google.com/looker/docs/reference/param-model-access-grant) restrict fields; SAML and OpenID sign-in; SCIM is in[preview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/iam/docs/workforce-identity-federation-scim) . Cloud Audit Logs are available, and compliance certifications apply to Enterprise and Embed editions.
- AI: Gemini in Looker, Conversational Analytics, and a Code Interpreter for Python analysis.
- Embedding:[Embed SDK](https://cloud.google.com/looker/docs/embed-sdk-intro) ; signed embedding requires the Embed edition.
- Not ideal for: finance teams without an analytics engineer to maintain LookML.


**Tradeoffs.** Looker gives finance the most auditable metric definitions, but it is quote-only, needs LookML skills, and has no spreadsheet-style write-back for budgets.


## Which BI tools let CFOs ask finance questions in plain English?


ThoughtSpot and Basedash are both built around asking questions rather than building dashboards first. ThoughtSpot leans on a modeled dataset and automated change analysis; Basedash writes SQL against connected sources and can send scheduled AI write-ups.


### ThoughtSpot


**Best for:** CFOs and finance leaders who want search-style questions, automatic change analysis, and KPI anomaly alerts on modeled warehouse data.


ThoughtSpot’s[Spotter](https://docs.thoughtspot.com/cloud/26.10.0.cl/spotter) is an AI analyst that plans and runs multi-step analysis, and[SpotIQ](https://docs.thoughtspot.com/cloud/26.10.0.cl/spotiq-custom) runs outlier, trend, and change analysis, which suits questions like “what drove the change in COGS.”[KPI monitors](https://docs.thoughtspot.com/cloud/26.10.0.cl/monitor-alert-anomaly) alert subscribers when a KPI falls outside its predicted range, and[Liveboard schedules](https://docs.thoughtspot.com/cloud/26.8.0.cl/liveboard-schedule) send PDF, CSV, or Excel files.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Essentials $25 per user per month (5 to 50 users), Pro $50 per user per month with 25 Spotter queries per user per month, billed annually; Enterprise custom](https://www.thoughtspot.com/pricing) . A usage-based Pro option starts at $0.10 per credit. Verified October 15, 2026.
- Free trial:[14 days](https://www.thoughtspot.com/trial) , no credit card.
- Deployment: ThoughtSpot Cloud; self-hosted ThoughtSpot Software is documented but not on the pricing page.
- Data sources:[Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, PostgreSQL, and others](https://docs.thoughtspot.com/cloud/26.10.0.cl/connections) through live connections.
- Query model: live queries on the warehouse; an in-memory cache is an add-on.
- Security:[row-level security](https://docs.thoughtspot.com/cloud/26.10.0.cl/security-rls) on all plans and[column-level security](https://docs.thoughtspot.com/cloud/26.10.0.cl/security-data-object) ; SAML SSO on Pro and Enterprise only;[SCIM](https://docs.thoughtspot.com/cloud/26.10.0.cl/group-user-management-scim) supported.[Security audit events](https://docs.thoughtspot.com/cloud/26.10.0.cl/audit-logs) stay in the system for 30 days, and SIEM export goes through support. SOC 2 Type II per the[ThoughtSpot trust center](https://www.thoughtspot.com/trust/security) .
- AI: Spotter agents on Pro and Enterprise; KPI anomaly alerts on all plans.
- Embedding:[Visual Embed SDK](https://developers.thoughtspot.com/docs/tsembed) .
- Not ideal for: teams that need SSO on the entry plan, or finance data that has not been modeled yet.


**Tradeoffs.** ThoughtSpot is strong at “why did this number move,” but SSO starts at Pro, Pro caps Spotter at 25 queries per user per month, and audit events only stay in the product for 30 days.


### Basedash


**Best for:** startup and mid-market finance teams that want to ask questions across accounting, billing, and warehouse data in plain English and receive scheduled AI write-ups, without building a pipeline.


Basedash’s[AI data analyst](https://www.basedash.com/features/ai-data-analyst) turns questions such as “compare Q3 operating expenses to budget by department” into SQL, charts, and dashboards.[Basedash Warehouse](https://www.basedash.com/features/warehouse) syncs finance sources such as[NetSuite SuiteAnalytics](https://www.basedash.com/data-sources/netsuite-suiteanalytics) ,[QuickBooks](https://www.basedash.com/data-sources/quickbooks) ,[Xero](https://www.basedash.com/data-sources/xero) , Sage Intacct, Stripe, Ramp, and Brex through Fivetran-powered connectors that Basedash manages, so no separate Fivetran account is needed.[Automations](https://www.basedash.com/features/automations) run daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly, or when a SQL query detects changed data, and send an AI-written analysis by email or Slack, which covers a recurring variance commentary.[Models](https://www.basedash.com/features/models) define shared measures such as revenue or burn so every AI answer uses the same logic.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Startup plan at $1,000 per month plus AI usage](https://www.basedash.com/pricing) for up to 25 users, with $1,000 per month of AI credits included; Enterprise is custom. Monthly and annual billing. Verified October 15, 2026.
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card.
- Deployment: cloud (servers in San Francisco);[self-hosting](https://www.basedash.com/docs/self-hosting/overview) on Enterprise.
- Data sources: direct connections to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and ClickHouse, plus 750+ SaaS sources synced into Basedash Warehouse.
- Query model: live queries on connected databases and warehouses; synced sources refresh[as often as every 15 minutes or once a day](https://www.basedash.com/features/data-ingestion) ; dashboards auto-refresh every 15 minutes by default.
- Security:[data source access control](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/data-source-access-control) by group or member, enforced in charts, AI chat, exports, and the SQL editor;[row-level security](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/row-level-security) for Postgres data sources only;[SAML or OIDC SSO](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/sso) ,[SCIM](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/scim) , and audit logs on Enterprise. SOC 2 Type II per the[security docs](https://www.basedash.com/docs/essentials/security) .
- AI: AI chat to SQL and charts, an[insights feed](https://www.basedash.com/features/insights) of AI-generated posts on what changed, scheduled automations, and an[MCP server](https://www.basedash.com/features/mcp-server) for Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other MCP clients.
- Embedding: dashboards and the full app, including a React SDK, on Enterprise.
- Not ideal for: FP&A teams that need Excel-style formula modeling, pixel-perfect statements, or department-level row filtering on synced ERP data.


**Tradeoffs.** Basedash gets a small finance team from QuickBooks or NetSuite to answers fastest, but row-level security only covers Postgres sources, so synced accounting data cannot be filtered by department today, and SSO, SCIM, and audit logs need Enterprise. A five-person team pays more than it would on Power BI Pro. The[Basedash for finance page](https://www.basedash.com/lp/bi-for-finance) shows the finance workflows.


## Which BI tool fits a lean finance team on a budget?


### Metabase


**Best for:** small finance teams with one technical person who want a free self-hosted option or a cheap hosted plan, and can live without row-level security until Pro.


Metabase queries the database directly, and its[dashboard subscriptions](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/dashboards/subscriptions) can attach a PDF to an email or Slack message on a schedule, which covers a basic monthly pack.[Alerts](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/questions/alerts) fire when a question returns results or a time series crosses a goal line.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Open Source free (AGPL); Starter $100 per month including 5 users, then $6 per user; Pro $575 per month including 10 users, then $12 per user; Enterprise from $20,000 per year](https://www.metabase.com/pricing) . Verified October 15, 2026.
- Free trial: 14 days on Starter and Pro.
- Deployment: Open Source self-hosted; Starter cloud only; Pro and Enterprise cloud or self-hosted.
- Data sources:[PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and others](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/databases/connecting) .
- Query model: queries run in your database, with caching on every plan and granular caching on Pro and Enterprise.
- Security:[row and column security](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/permissions/row-and-column-security) on Pro and Enterprise only, and it does not apply to SQL questions;[SAML](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/people-and-groups/authenticating-with-saml) and[SCIM](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/people-and-groups/user-provisioning) on Pro and Enterprise;[usage analytics](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/usage-and-performance-tools/usage-analytics) audit trail on Pro and Enterprise, kept 720 days. SOC 2 Type II for Metabase Cloud.
- AI:[Metabot](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/ai/metabot) builds charts from natural language and writes SQL; bring your own AI key on any plan, or use Metabase’s service at $3.75 per million tokens. No documented anomaly detection.
- Embedding: guest embeds on all plans; modular embedding and the React SDK on Pro and Enterprise.
- Not ideal for: finance teams that need department-level access control on the Starter budget.


**Tradeoffs.** Metabase is the cheapest path to shared finance dashboards, but the controls finance usually needs (row-level security, SSO, audit trail) start at $575 per month, and there is no write-back or spreadsheet modeling.


## How do these BI tools connect to NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, and SAP?


Most finance data starts in an ERP or accounting system, and few BI tools connect to those systems directly anymore.

## How should finance teams handle row-level security, audit logs, and SOX controls?


A divisional controller should see only their entity’s P&L, and an auditor should be able to see who accessed what. The tools differ in where those controls live:


- **In the semantic model:** Looker access filters, Omni access filters, Power BI roles, and Tableau user filters are defined in the BI layer. Looker and Omni definitions sit in model code that can be reviewed like any other change; Looker’s access filter has to be added to each Explore, and Power BI roles do not restrict workspace editors.
- **In the workbook or dataset:** Sigma and ThoughtSpot apply row-level security from user attributes or group rules, and both document column-level security for fields like compensation.
- **In the database:** Basedash passes the user’s groups to Postgres so database policies filter rows, which keeps policy in one place but only works on Postgres today.
- **Audit retention:** Metabase Pro keeps 720 days of activity, Tableau Enterprise 365 days, Omni at least a year in your own storage, ThoughtSpot 30 days in product, and Power BI’s activity API 28 days, with longer retention in Microsoft Purview.


For a feature-by-feature breakdown, see our[row-level security comparison](https://www.basedash.com/blog/best-bi-tools-for-row-level-security-compared-2026) .


## Which BI tool should your finance team choose?


- **Series C SaaS company with an ERP, a warehouse, and department-level access:** Sigma or Omni if FP&A builds the models, Looker if an analytics engineer owns metric definitions. All three apply row-level security from user attributes on live warehouse data.
- **FP&A analysts who live in Excel:** Sigma for input tables and pivot tables on the warehouse; Power BI if the team needs Analyze in Excel and Microsoft 365.
- **Board decks and monthly packs:** Power BI for PowerPoint and paginated report export, Tableau for prebuilt income statement and balance sheet Accelerators.
- **Automated variance commentary:** ThoughtSpot SpotIQ change analysis on modeled data, or Basedash automations that send a written analysis on a schedule. Pair either with a clear[budget vs. actual report structure](https://www.basedash.com/blog/how-to-build-a-budget-vs-actual-report-variance-analysis) .
- **Small team on QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite without a warehouse:** Basedash, which syncs those sources for you, or Metabase if someone can run a pipeline and self-host.
- **SOX-minded team that needs SSO and audit logs at a known price:** Metabase Pro, Tableau Enterprise, or ThoughtSpot Pro publish prices that include SSO; Sigma, Omni, and Looker require a quote.


## Frequently asked questions


### What BI tool should a Series C finance director use to connect ERP and warehouse data with department-level security?


Start with Sigma, Omni, or Looker. All three query the warehouse live, so ERP data synced into Snowflake or BigQuery sits next to billing and CRM data, and all three filter rows by user attribute, which maps cleanly to departments or cost centers. Sigma suits FP&A teams that build models themselves, Omni suits teams that want spreadsheet tabs on a semantic model, and Looker suits companies with an analytics engineer. If the CFO mostly wants to ask questions in plain English, add ThoughtSpot to the shortlist; its row-level security is included on every plan.


### What are the top BI tools for finance teams doing FP&A?


For FP&A specifically, the deciding feature is whether analysts can model and enter plan data. Sigma input tables and Omni input columns write values back to the warehouse, so budgets and actuals can be compared in one query. Power BI translytical task flows write to Fabric databases, which helps Microsoft shops. Tableau, Looker, ThoughtSpot, and Metabase do not document native budget write-back, so they are better for reporting on plans built elsewhere. Teams that need full planning workflows often pair a BI tool with a dedicated FP&A planning platform such as Pigment, Datarails, or Cube.


### Which dashboard tools automate budget vs. actual variance reporting with AI explanations?


ThoughtSpot SpotIQ runs change analysis that breaks down what drove a metric’s movement, and its KPI monitors alert when a metric leaves its predicted range. Basedash automations can run monthly or when new data lands and send an AI-written variance summary to email or Slack. Tableau Pulse sends digests of personalized metric insights on every edition. Power BI Copilot can summarize a variance report, but only on F2 or larger Fabric capacity or P1 Premium. In every case, the explanation is only as good as the budget and actuals tables it reads, so model those first.


### Which BI tools offer audit logs, SSO, and a SOC 2 report for a SOX-ready finance team?


Sigma, Omni, Looker, ThoughtSpot, Metabase Cloud, and Basedash all document SOC 2 Type II reports, but SSO and audit logs are often plan-gated. Metabase includes SAML, SCIM, and a 720-day audit trail on Pro at $575 per month. ThoughtSpot includes SAML on Pro, not Essentials, and keeps security events for 30 days. Tableau keeps a year of activity logs on Enterprise. Basedash includes SSO, SCIM, and audit logs on Enterprise only. Power BI uses Microsoft Entra ID and Purview auditing. SOX itself does not certify software, so auditors will still review your access policies and change controls.


### Which BI tools are best for finance reporting and board decks?


Power BI is the strongest fit for decks: each report page exports to a PowerPoint slide, and paginated reports export print-ready statements to PDF, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Tableau exports sheets to PowerPoint as static images and to vector PDF. Looker, Omni, and ThoughtSpot schedule PDF deliveries, with Omni and ThoughtSpot also sending Excel files. Metabase and Basedash deliver dashboard snapshots by email or Slack, which works for weekly updates but not for formatted board packs.


### Which BI tools have good templates for finance dashboards?


Tableau has the most finance templates: free Accelerators on Tableau Exchange include Budget Controlling (actual vs. budget vs. last year), Income Statement, Balance Sheet with budget, and Financial Statement dashboards. Sigma publishes a Budget Variance Analysis app template and an FP&A report template on its QuickStarts site. Other tools rely on AI generation or community examples rather than packaged finance templates. Templates still need mapping to your chart of accounts, so expect setup time either way.


### What is a lightweight BI platform for a 20-person company using Excel and QuickBooks?


Power BI and Tableau both dropped their QuickBooks Online connectors in 2025, so a small company has three practical options. Basedash syncs QuickBooks into a managed warehouse and answers questions in plain English, at $1,000 per month for up to 25 users. Metabase Starter costs $100 per month for five users but needs QuickBooks data in a database first, through a pipeline someone maintains. A dedicated accounting reporting tool can also cover P&L and cash flow without a BI layer.


### Can finance dashboards on BigQuery and NetSuite update in near real time?


Freshness depends on the NetSuite sync more than the BI tool. Live-query tools such as Sigma, Omni, Looker, ThoughtSpot, and Basedash read BigQuery directly, so dashboards are as current as the last NetSuite sync into BigQuery. Power BI Import mode refreshes up to 8 times a day on Pro or 48 on PPU, while DirectQuery reads the source on each view. Basedash’s managed NetSuite connector syncs as often as every 15 minutes. Sub-second refresh of ERP data is not realistic for any of these tools, because NetSuite itself is the bottleneck.
